patch_resolves_note: The staged patch inserts the missing `if (uc == ue) goto out;` guard immediately after `uc = json_skip_space(uc, ue);` in `json_parse_array()`. The fixed original cleanly guards the exact `[ ` witness, and the adjacent `[ ]` perturbation shows the close-bracket probe still executes when the post-skip cursor remains in bounds.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project parser step that materializes the attacker-controlled bytes and their exact logical extent into the JSON parser state.
After `json_skip_space()` may advance `uc` to `ue`, the array parser dereferences `*uc` without the missing `if (uc == ue) goto out;` guard that the patch inserts at this exact point.
AddressSanitizer sink. Evaluating this condition reads one byte from `uc == ue`, so the parser dereferences the third byte of a logical 2-byte input.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `array_post_skip.uc_ptr == array_close_probe.probe_ptr` on the original crash path.
